entries.label: Company control plane
entries.correction: Our own check was wrong, not the app. The app improved: it started refusing signed-out visitors with a proper redirect instead of a page that bounced them a second later. Our check was still looking for the old behaviour and called the improvement a partial outage. Fixed in the prober the same day.

entries.label: Public website
entries.correction: Our own check looked for a sentence that had been rewritten on the site. The page was serving normally in about a quarter of a second. The check now looks for something the page structure carries rather than something a writer edits.

entries.label: Published websites
entries.correction: The same bot filter, once the prober learned to recognise it. This entry records our check becoming honest about being blocked, not a change in the service.

entries.label: Published websites
entries.correction: Our own check was stopped by a bot filter in front of the sites, and graded that as the sites being broken. Every published website was serving normally throughout.

entries.label: Website studio
entries.correction: Our own check was wrong, not the studio. It expected the page to refuse an unauthenticated visitor and the page correctly served one, so the check called a working page a partial outage. Fixed in the prober the same day.
